source.name: DOCKSTRING PARP1
source.targetProtocolNote: DOCKSTRING published PARP1 scores use a distinct protocol from the separately executed Webina/PDB4R6E four-compound demo; do not pool their scores or imply common calibration.

scoreType: AutoDock Vina docking score; not measured affinity
selection: Seeded ID-order shuffle within existing independent dataset splits; at most256/64/64; no score-based sampling

trainingSpikes.encoding: All139255 spike flags per circuit step; LSB-first sorted-engine index. Membrane voltages not retained.

circuit.encoder: Authored canonical-SMILES token/descriptor sensory pulses; labels never enter encoder or circuit

mechanism: Fixed full measured-connectome reservoir; only engineered appetitive readout weights learn. NOT biological whole-brain synaptic learning or native proboscis physiology.
limitations: This is supervised reward imitation of DOCKSTRING scores, not physical protein-ligand affinity measurement.
Only a plastic readout is trained; measured connectome weights remain fixed.
Sensory encoding and appetitive response are authored proxies, not demonstrated chemoreceptor or feeding physiology.
Frozen predictions are evaluated on heldout compounds. Feature generation never sees docking score; test labels used only for metrics.
Performance is reported whether favorable or not; no claim of improvement over molecular-only ML without evidence.
